CRITICAL_WRITER: Future qualified outside observer writer under separately issued evidence scope; survives workload stop within existing observer window
EXHAUSTION: No silent required-event discard. Stop normal publication/scheduling, preserve consumption, attempt only preallocated critical slots; insufficient/failed critical evidence makes overall qualification INCOMPLETE. Independent verifier defaults to incomplete if final outcome is absent.
FIRST_CAUSE: Immutable exact coded cause and actually preserved bounded witness; unavailable evidence explicit INCOMPLETE
NORMAL_ADMISSION: Only admit normal bytes if cumulative normal precharges remain <=65536-R; all critical and normal charges combined<=65536.
NORMATIVE_STATUS: Prospective rule only, not measured reserve or granted post-deadline writing
RESERVE_RULE: Before any execution grant may activate, independently derive finite reserve R from exact bounded schemas, feasible event counts, actual witnesses and finalization path; include R within65536. No number/percentage chosen here.
